recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32456; related FHIR-32450 can be audited separately, and FHIR-32459 is already represented on the combined branch.
issue_request: FHIR-32456 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification Security WG issue for AuditEvent asking that Email and URI not be treated as media because network addresses/protocols are captured elsewhere; its final resolution clarified media as persistence media and pointed to the FHIR-32450/FHIR-32459 changes.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-32456 was found. The related commit 3d204189e23e03f0b4f11d03d491bc1d868e399b implemented the connected FHIR-32450/FHIR-32459 block-vote changes by removing AuditEvent.agent.media, replacing AuditEvent.agent.network.address/type with AuditEvent.agent.network[x], and adding AuditEvent.entity.agent with persistence-media wording.
additional_context: FHIR-32450 supplied the concrete media model by removing .agent.media and adding .entity.agent; FHIR-32459 supplied the network[x] endpoint model. Security WG minutes on 2021-08-23 discussed FHIR-32456 with those issues and recorded the persistence-media versus network distinction, and the 2021-09-13 block vote approved the issue family 8-0-1.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini; current source defines AuditEvent.agent.network[x] as Reference(Endpoint), uri, or string and defines AuditEvent.entity.agent with persistence-media wording. Current checks found no active AuditEvent.agent.media, network-type, or audit-media-type binding, only migration mappings and retained OID registry entries.
